c74object.name: gst.recorddata
c74object.digest: Record/playback 3 triplets : 3 lists sig1, sig2 and sig3 of 3 floating values.
c74object.description:
gst.recorddata records/playback 3 triplets : 3 lists sig1, sig2 and sig3 of 3 floating values in a mubu container.
Uses imubu , mubu , mubu.track , mubu.record and mubu.play of MuBu package from ISMM team at IRCAM Centre Pompidou http://ismm.ircam.fr/pipo/. During playback, gst.recorddata spread the sample rate and the sample period internally and every 3sec to any gother gst treatment that require.

attribute.name: bounds
attribute.digest: list [float float] specifying min max display
attribute.description:
list [float float] specifying min max vertical display of imubu object
You can also use the last inlet for imubu by sending the folowing messages :
- "view 0 bounds min max
- "view sig1 bounds min max"
- "view sig2 bounds min max"
- "view sig3 bounds min max"

attribute.name: maxduration
attribute.digest: Maximum duration of the recording [float] in ms (les than 1 hour).
attribute.description: Changing the maximum duration reallocates memory. Use it carefully!

attribute.name: autoscale
attribute.digest: Autoscale (1/0) adjust the range of value in imubu while recording.
attribute.description:
if off (0) use @bounds attribute to set min/max. You can also use the last inlet for imubu by sending the folowing messages :
- "view 0 bounds min max
- "view sig1 bounds min max"
- "view sig2 bounds min max"
- "view sig3 bounds min max"

method.name: list
method.digest:
For the last inlet ( imubu messages) see possible messages of imubu object.
ex. "readall PATH/datafile.mubu" to load a file.
